other_failure_modes.name: Lookahead Bias / Target Leakage
other_failure_modes.description: The agent engineers features using future information (e.g. using `shift(-1)` to look at the next transaction) on a concatenated train and test dataset. This leaks the occurrence and characteristics of future test-set events into the training data, allowing the model to 'cheat' by knowing if a user will make another transaction in the future.

summary: The agent implements a strong temporal validation strategy and sophisticated feature engineering, but introduces a critical data leak by using `shift(-1)` on the combined train and test sets to compute differences to future transactions. Additionally, the agent fits an OrdinalEncoder on test data before splitting, ignores explicit missing value imputation, and only evaluates its stochastic models once using a single metric.
